Site.name: Sadak Smriti
Site.sampleData: Sample data: names, crashes and figures are invented

Home.metaTitle: Sadak Smriti: road deaths in Nepal, remembered and recorded
Home.metaDescription: Every reported road crash in Nepal, with its sources, and a page for every person killed. Open data for research.
Home.hoursAgo: {count, plural, one {# hour ago} other {# hours ago}}
Home.mapAlt: Map of Nepal’s national highways, coloured by deaths per km, with the places of recent crashes
Home.rememberedBody: On {date} we remember people killed on this day in earlier years. Their families wrote these pages.
Home.weekBody: Published crashes, newest first. Each one is checked by a reviewer.
Home.newsBody: Headlines link to the outlet. We never copy article text.
Home.policeBody: Nepal Police yearly district totals beside what we have recorded. Background figures only.
Home.ctaReportHeading: Know of a crash we haven’t recorded?
Home.ctaReportBody: Paste a news link, or send an anonymous tip. A reviewer checks it, usually within 24 hours.
Home.ctaReportBodyShort: A reviewer checks every report, usually within 24 hours.
Home.ctaMemoryBody: Families can claim a memorial page, add photos and a life story, and decide who sees it.

Map.metaTitle: Map of road crashes in Nepal
Map.heading: Map of road crashes
Map.failed: The map could not load. The list of crashes still works.
Map.gestureHint: Use two fingers to move the map
Map.periodHint: Drag the handles to compare months
Map.namedSummary: {named} named · {unnamed} not yet named · Confirmed by {outlets} outlets and a reviewer

Crash.verified: ✓ Confirmed by {count} outlets and a reviewer
Crash.disagreeBody: The published value is marked. Expand a row to see who said what, and when.
Crash.namesSummary: 5 of 8 names spelled more than one way. 2 ages differ.

Person.coverNote: Cover photo · chosen by family · shown in black and white
Person.embedsBody: Nothing loads from YouTube or Facebook until you tap.
Person.newsSaidBody: Spellings and ages as each outlet printed them.
Person.family: I am family or a friend
Person.storyPending: Their story hasn't been written yet
Person.storyPendingBody: Families can add a life story, photos and links. Until then, this page shows what the news reported.

Remember.metaTitle: Remember the people killed on Nepal's roads
Remember.heading: Remember
Remember.intro: Each crash, and the people we lost in it. Open a crash to see what happened, or a person to read the page their family made.
Remember.anniversary: {count, plural, one {# year ago today} other {# years ago today}}
Remember.notYetNamed: {n, plural, one {{count} person not yet named} other {{count} people not yet named}}
Remember.withheld: {n, plural, one {{count} name withheld at the family's request} other {{count} names withheld at the families' request}}

Contribute.heading: Contribute
Contribute.intro: Sadak Smriti is kept by volunteers. Report a crash you know about, check reports as a reviewer, write code, translate, or help pay for the server.

report.title: Report a crash
report.body: Tell us about a crash. No account needed. A reviewer checks it.

review.title: Become a reviewer
review.body: Check news drafts and reports before they are published. Reviewers are invited.

code.title: Write code or translate
code.body: The code is open source (AGPL-3.0). Fix a bug, improve a page, or check the Nepali.

donate.title: Donate
donate.body: Pays for the server, backups and news extraction. Every rupee is shown on the transparency page.

Contribute.peopleBody: Everyone listed here asked to be. To add yourself, see content/README.md in the code.
Contribute.anonymousDonors: {n, plural, one {and {count} donor who asked not to be named} other {and {count} donors who asked not to be named}}

highlights.months: {n, plural, one {{count} month} other {{count} months}} helping

Contribute.shareBody: A card for Instagram, Facebook or WhatsApp stories and posts. Nothing is uploaded: the card is made on your phone.
Contribute.cardTagline: Remembering everyone killed on Nepal's roads
Contribute.shareText: I help keep Sadak Smriti, the record of everyone killed on Nepal's roads.
Contribute.photoNote: Photos are kept on our own server. LinkedIn photos can't be used: LinkedIn doesn't allow it.

Highway.perKmBody: Rolling 3 years. Segments with 3 or more fatal crashes are blackspots.
Highway.chartNote: Hover or tap a bar for its value. The table under each chart has every number.
Highway.noRecent: No recent crashes recorded on this highway.
Highway.notFound: We have no page for this highway yet.

Data.downloadsNote: Rebuilt nightly. Monthly frozen snapshots. No names or memorial content.
Data.ageSex: Age and sex of people killed
Data.vsPoliceBody: Same months, FY 2083/84 to date. Shows how much we undercount.
Data.heading: Research data
Data.intro: Every number here comes from the same records as the downloads and the public API. Each chart has a table of its numbers and a CSV.
Data.filtersPending: Filters will work when the first real records are published. Until then the charts show all of Nepal, this year.
Data.downloadsPending: The files are published with the first real data.
Data.byDistrictBody: Darker means more people killed. Hover or tap a district for its number.
Data.causesBody: What a source said caused each crash. These are early reports, not findings of fault.
Data.crashSizeBody: Most fatal crashes kill one person. A few large crashes, often buses, kill many.
Data.highwaysBody: People killed per 100 km of highway, this year.
Data.ageSexNote: {count} people whose age and sex were reported.
Data.coverageBody: We count the deaths that news outlets and people report to us. That undercounts, most of all in remote districts. The police comparison shows by how much. Natural hazards (landslides, floods, rockfall) are counted separately.

Report.whereBody: Drop a pin, or choose the place from the lists.
Report.pinHint: Drag the map to move the pin · inside Nepal only
Report.dupNone: None of these, it’s a new crash
Report.killedHint: Include people who died later in hospital
Report.estimateNote: You can add the people’s names later. If you’re not sure of a number, give your best estimate and say so in the sources step.

form.heading: Report a crash
form.intro: Tell us about a crash on Nepal's roads. It takes about two minutes. A reviewer checks every report before anything is published.
form.placeNameHint: A village, bazaar, bridge or bend people would recognise
form.sourceHint: Give a news link, or tell us what you saw or heard. At least one is needed.
form.witnessHint: Only reviewers read this. It is never published.
form.contactHint: Only reviewers see this, to ask a question about your report. We delete it 30 days after the report is checked.
form.noscript: This form needs JavaScript switched on for its anti-spam check. You can still read the rest of the site without it.
form.thanksBody: A reviewer will check this, usually within 24 hours. Nothing is published until then.
form.thanksAdded: Thank you. Your information was added to the crash for a reviewer to check.

errors.dateFuture: The date can't be in the future.
errors.dateOld: We record crashes from the last 20 years.
errors.killed: Enter a whole number from 0 to 200.
errors.injured: Enter a whole number from 0 to 200.
errors.source: Give a news link, or tell us what you saw.
errors.url: Enter a full web link starting with http:// or https://
errors.tooLong: This is too long. Please shorten it.
errors.contact: Enter an email address or a phone number.
errors.captcha: The anti-spam check failed. Please try again.
errors.hour: You have sent several reports in the last hour. Please try again later.
errors.day: You have sent the most reports allowed today. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.site: We're receiving many reports right now. Please try again tomorrow.
errors.closed: Reporting is paused for a short while. Please try again later.
errors.failed: Something went wrong and the report wasn't saved. Please try again.

NotFound.heading: This page is not here
NotFound.body: The address may be wrong, or this part of the site is still being built.

Auth.loginIntro: Sign in with your Google account to help record crashes. Reading the site never needs an account.
Auth.privacy: From Google we keep only your name, email address and picture. We never post anything for you.
Auth.notConfigured: Sign-in is not set up on this server yet.
Auth.failed: Sign-in did not finish. Please try again.
Auth.contributorNext: More ways to contribute with an account are coming. For now you can report a crash.
Auth.deactivatedNotice: This account has been deactivated by the site's reviewers. You can still read the site. If you think this is a mistake, please contact the project.

TwoFactor.title: Confirm it's you
TwoFactor.codeIntro: Enter the 6-digit code your authenticator app shows for Sadak Smriti. You are asked again every 12 hours.
TwoFactor.setupIntro: Reviewers and admins confirm a code from an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Aegis. It takes a minute and protects the people named on this site.
TwoFactor.scan: Scan this code with your authenticator app, or type the key below into it.
TwoFactor.qrLabel: QR code for your authenticator app
TwoFactor.backupNote: Save these somewhere safe. If you lose your phone, each one works once. They are shown only now.
TwoFactor.wrongCode: That code did not work. Codes change every 30 seconds; try the newest one.
TwoFactor.locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait 15 minutes, then try again.
TwoFactor.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
TwoFactor.needsCode: Confirm with your authenticator app to use the review area.

Review.heading: News to check
Review.intro: Articles that the automatic collection found and that look like road-crash news. Open each one. If it is a crash, report it with the article's link, then mark it done. Mark anything else as not a road crash.
Review.empty: Nothing to check. New articles are collected every 30 minutes.
Review.runQueued: Collection is queued. New articles appear here within a few minutes.
Review.runBusy: A collection is already waiting or running.
Review.noRuns: No collection has run yet. Is the worker running? (pnpm worker)

Accounts.heading: Accounts
Accounts.intro: Everyone who has signed in with Google. Admins can make a contributor a reviewer. Reviewers and admins can deactivate a contributor who misuses the site. Every change is logged.
Accounts.adminNote: Admins are made on the server and cannot be changed here.
Accounts.roleChanged: Changing a role signs the person out; the new role applies when they sign in again.

Submissions.heading: Reports to review
Submissions.intro: Crash reports and additions sent in by visitors, waiting for a decision. Crashes with 3 or more deaths come first, then the oldest.
Submissions.empty: Nothing is waiting for a decision.

result.waiting: Your approval is recorded. A second, different reviewer is needed before it goes public.
result.already_decided: You have already decided this report.
result.unsupported: This kind of report cannot be decided here yet.

Submissions.currentRecord: The crash as it stands now
Submissions.hasContact: The reporter left contact details. They are kept encrypted and deleted 30 days after a decision.
Submissions.duplicatesNone: No other crash within 2 days in this district.
Submissions.approveHint: Approving makes a new crash public. Check the source first.
Submissions.approveHintAddition: Approving adds this source to the public crash.
Submissions.cannotOwn: You cannot decide your own submission.
Submissions.alreadyDecided: You have already decided this report.

Edit.listIntro: Every crash, public or draft. Open one to edit its facts, vehicles, sources and people.
Edit.heading: Edit crash
Edit.reason: Why are you changing this? (kept in the history)
Edit.conflict: Someone else changed this while you were editing. Reload the page and try again.
Edit.invalidSummary: Please fix the fields marked below.

refused.closed: This crash can no longer be changed here.

error.future: The date cannot be in the future
error.name: Enter a name in English or Nepali
error.url: Enter a full web address starting with https://
error.belowPeople: Fewer than the people already recorded as killed
error.tooManyKilled: More people would be recorded as killed than the crash's death count
error.killedNeedsNewsSource: A person can be published as killed only when the crash has a news source
error.noSource: Add a news source before publishing
error.pendingReview: This report is still in the review queue. Decide it there.
error.alreadyHere: This link is already on this crash
error.linkedElsewhere: This link belongs to a different crash

Edit.publishNote: A crash needs at least one source to be public.
Edit.peopleHint: {recorded} of {deaths} killed are recorded by name.
Edit.familyAsked: The family asked to show this child's name
Edit.childNote: An injured child's name stays hidden unless the family asked to show it.
Edit.removeNote: Removed people stay in the history and can be restored.
Edit.historyIntro: Every change to this crash and the people in it. Restoring puts an earlier version back as a new version; nothing is erased.
